description: This Java class defines an immutable representation of a 'Thing ID' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides various static factory methods for creating instances from strings, namespace and name, or generating random IDs, and includes a method for retrieving the entity type.

classes.name: ThingId
classes.description: An immutable class representing a validated ID for a 'Thing' within the Eclipse Ditto framework, extending NamespacedEntityIdWithType.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ThingId instance from a CharSequence, skipping validation if the input is already a ThingId.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ThingId instance using a namespace and name.

methods.name: inDefaultNamespace
methods.description: Creates a ThingId with a default namespace placeholder and a given name.

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.description: Generates a new unique ThingId with a random UUID as the name.

methods.name: dummy
methods.description: Returns a dummy ThingId instance that should not be used for entities.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type associated with a 'Thing'.
